what: Burger builds itself: lettuce and tomato fall, patty sears, cheese drapes, onion rings drop, bun lands. Ends on the finished burger.
A hand-drawn stick man climbs into a real photo of a rice bowl, dances on it, gets splashed and climbs out with a spoon. Name on top.
A burger floats down on a parachute in front of a huge BURGER word on red and lands.
Stop motion: a khachapuri is eaten bite by bite from above until the plate is empty, then the name and a chef appear.
One slice of chocolate cake on a flat plum ground, bites disappear from it one by one, then it is whole again. Loops on its own.
One flavour word repeated huge behind the can (GRAPE GRAPE GRAPE), cut to the next flavour and colour, ends on PICK YOUR POP with the whole range.
Coffee cups fall from the top and fill a pixel heart one cup at a time; when it is full: YOU WON! Your heart with coffee.
A cafe photo with a washing line: croissant, matcha, a 20% off tag, a pastry and an Order now card hang on pegs and slide past.
NO SUGAR NO FAT stays; each bottle gets its own colour screen, then all of them in a grid, then the logo on black.
Each ingredient falls into a bowl with its name beside it (oregano, feta, olive), then the finished dish. Ingredients named as they fall.
JUST DO IT wraps round the shoe as a 3D ring of letters that spins; the product stays still in the middle.
Tilt-shift night street corner, an empty lot; the restaurant rises out of the ground as a giant burger building with a neon sign.
The word CHEESE split over two lines, the burger slides in between them, the yellow arches wipe the screen to the red logo.
Half the screen the pack, half what it tastes like (cinnamon roll, eggs, latte, cereal), in that flavour's colour with two numbers at the bottom.
Story ad in four beats: CRAVING SOMETHING BIG? / IT'S WHAT'S INSIDE THAT COUNTS (burger splits into layers) / JUICY CHEESY PERFECTLY STACKED / ONE BIG BITE. ORDER NOW.
DELICIOUS BURGER in big outlined letters, the burger in front of the word with smoke drifting behind.
BITE INTO THE CREAMY CRUNCH: a hand pulls half the sandwich away, then the plate and the name.
Chocolate made in front of you: pieces break, chocolate pours over the logo square, salt falls, a woman takes a bite, the box.
Eggs, flour and a rolling pin whirl in the air and turn into a cake with raspberries on a stand.
HAPPY HANUKKAH: the candles of the menorah light one at a time, shamash first. Loops by itself.
WHICH ONE WILL YOU CHOOSE? Bottles fly in one by one with the flavour written huge and sideways behind each.
TIME TO TRY SOMETHING NEW? Cans shuffle like a cup game behind a question mark, one is picked: THE DRINK EVERYONE'S TALKING ABOUT.
Hard cuts between colours, each frame one more word: OUR / BIGGEST / SALE / EVER, a face, 25% OFF.
A calendar of the month on red: the sale days light up one by one, then the dates in words.
Sale bags float down on pink parachutes over a city, the 40 on the bag in front.
The burger lifts into floating layers (bun, patty, cheese, bun) and settles back, a bottle beside it.
One can per colour: the background and fruit change with each flavour, the can stays in the same place.
TAKE A JUICE BREAK, then each can with its flavour name huge in the background colour, ends on all three cans.
Burgers drop into a noughts-and-crosses grid on a yellow check; the mascot wins the line. A game in the post.
LOW BATTERY? on a Chanukah table, a jelly donut spins and charges with light: POWERED BY JELLY DONUTS!
What is better than / one pizza? It is 2! A second pizza slides in, then What are you pairing your pizza with?
A pot lid lifts and a bird flies out; it flies over fields into a castle town. The pot opens a story.
City names roll up like a slot machine round the T-shirt: KHARKIV, LVIV, ODESA, POLTAVA. Every place it ships to.
A map line runs from a landmark to the building with the minutes it takes, then drone views and the agent's face.
A finger swipes a row of menu cards (burger, fries, pizza, taco), then Don't wait / take a bite in big type.
Product photo becomes a close-up of its own knit texture while MARL KNIT / Plush Soft Texture types over it.
A moka pot turns into a mug, then HOCUS POCUS / I NEED COFFEE 2 FOCUS appears with sparkles.
Question (hungry?), the logo, two combos side by side, a phone with 40% off in the app, the last frame says where to get it.
Food photos slide in as angled panels; SMALL PRICE BIG TASTE, then Without burning your wallet, then the logo.
Huge grey PAN DULCE: BOSS LEVEL words; a little character peeks from behind the word and the pastry grows over it.
Can after can, each in its own colour with its flavour acted out, ends on POP. TASTE. CRUNCH. REPEAT. and the range.
ARE YOU READY? Watermelon slices fly, a watermelon splits into a carton: SIP ON FRESH WATERMELON FLAVOR.
Tomato, mozzarella and basil fall onto a plate and become the salad; pasta and bacon fall and become the pasta.
Illustrated snowy hill with tiny skiers, then the real coffee cup and a red glove on a wooden rail, then the logo.
One building for every kind of family: 2 and 2.5 room homes for small families, 3 and 4 for larger, each with its own picture, then the price and the button.
The can spins in the air while vanilla and banana slices float past it, then lands next to a second can on yellow.
FREE DESSERT / BIRTHDAY TREAT: three plates of dessert slide in and stack one after another on a warm sand ground.
Berries float, a milk ribbon spirals through them and wraps round the yogurt pot, which lands on a lilac plinth.
Choose your favourite coffee: a switch flips from Creamy to Black and the coffee in the cup changes with it.
Walls of one repeated word (DRAFT, PUNCH, STRAIGHT UP) cut hard to the next colour; a sticker shape bursts on one.
A wall of JUICE JUICE JUICE, the bottle in front, the wall glitches away and leaves the bottle on yellow.
Outlined SALE SALE SALE with one filled in, then a wall of 50% OFF, then SUMMER SALE.
One word at a time, each replacing the last: find / creative / flow on / monday? then a button pops in. Confetti dots.
Black cards punch in one line at a time: BUYING A PROPERTY / AFFORDABLE / TO RENT IN / TO LIVE / BEST, then a happy family photo.
Generated noodle commercial: bite, pink powder burst round the cup, face, cup on a marble counter with steam.
Restaurant tour: entrance, courtyard, a plate, a chef with a flaming pan, logo. Words on each shot.
Neon CYBER MONDAY frame flickers and glitches, 40% OFF pill, a cart drawn in one neon line.
Black Friday story posters flip through: countdown, tech deals, footwear frenzy, super sale.
Three story panels, the middle one swaps photo and headline, a play button pulses.
"Rain hits different. With the right snack." types on beside a woman by a rainy window, then the cake, then the pack on yellow.
"With tea" / "Without tea" / "Still tastes amazing": the same snack in two moments, then the pack.
Juice post template: the word JUICE wipes away and comes back as ORANGE, TOMATO, COMBINED, each with its own colour and fruit.
Colour bands sweep across the post; each pass swaps the chair and the band colour, SALE 50% OFF stays.

Kenetik, 20 s, AI made. Three limes drop and stack, then turn into the can; the can is cut in three slices with fruit inside, the slices spin and snap back together in a splash; a watermelon falls, splits open and the can bursts out; the camera rolls along the label in macro; the can drops onto a set with watermelon and lime slices, then the logo. The ingredients become the product, one continuous chain of events, no words until the logo. (Was in the 16 Nov Pinterest batch as pin 5 and wrongly not kept; Tzvi sent it back.)

Lay's, 7 s. A finger balances one bag; each tap flips it to the next flavour and the whole background turns that flavour's colour (green, yellow, orange, red), about a beat a second; ends on all the bags in a row. Best for flavours or varieties, not sizes (Tzvi).
A cookie wafer and cream crumbs on red tumble together, assemble into an ice-cream bar, a bite is taken with crumbs flying, and it lands as the wrapped pack with brand name.
lesson: Ingredients become the product, then the finished pack closes the clip.

what: Hundreds of chip slices fall and swirl through the air, gather into a bag that lands centre screen, then cut to the brand logo on a matching green.
lesson: One cause (falling pieces) builds the product; the colour of the ingredient is the colour of the ending.

what: A bar flies in through a ribbon of chocolate with cereal pieces orbiting, the pieces settle around it and it holds big and clear on blue.
lesson: A swirl of the real ingredients around one big product reads as taste with no words.

what: A frozen paratha pack is held up, goes onto a pan, puffs golden, is torn and scooped into a curry, and ends plated on a table.
lesson: Following the product from pack to plate is one chain of events a single photo-to-video clip can do.

what: Coffee beans tumble through the frame on yellow, swirl together and land as one wrapped coffee candy with its name, product big and centered.
lesson: Ingredients falling into frame should resolve into the finished product and hold on a clean name frame.

what: Chocolate chunks fly apart in the air, melt into a glossy swirl, then fuse back into one whole bar on blue.
lesson: Break the product into pieces and re-form it so the end frame is the clean whole product.

what: A burger's layers drop one by one onto a peach ground until the full exploded stack hangs in the air.
lesson: Show the product assembling piece by piece, each layer arriving on its own beat.

what: A peach is sliced into a spiral that swirls into a tunnel of orange and ends on a clean fruit colour field.
lesson: One continuous camera move through the product's own shape makes a clever transition.

what: Soft-serve cones fall in from both sides on a blue and orange split, then one swirl lands center with a bold headline.
lesson: Repeat the product falling into place, then lock to one large hero plus a headline.

what: Strawberry, banana and orange pieces float on yellow then come together as one bottle of juice in the centre.
lesson: Show real ingredients becoming the product to explain what is inside without words.

what: Chocolates stay fixed in the centre while the flat-lay around them swaps between desserts and colour grounds in beats, ending on blue cookies.
lesson: Keep the product fixed and swap its surroundings to show range in one clip.

what: A text ring spins in, a can lands, and the whole ground and fruit flip colour through three flavours, ending on yellow.
lesson: Change flavour by changing the background colour in a few quick, readable steps.

what: A tired office worker eats the cake, then flour with an egg yolk, milk splash and a cake slice show the ingredients, ending on the box on yellow with logo.
lesson: Show the ingredients as a short recipe beat between the moment of need and the pack shot.

what: A bottle label slides, ice drops into a glass, cola pours with splash and fizz, then a clean brand end frame.
lesson: Sequence: ice, pour, fizz, brand; each beat is one action.

what: Huge brand word slams in, a cup and coffee bags tumble in with beans, headline wipes across, ending with bag, cup and name in place.
lesson: Big type plus products landing in place gives a strong sound-off opening.

what: Cans of three colours tilt and roll in on white, one bursts into a pink liquid splash that forms the can.
lesson: One can per flavour, with a splash in that flavour colour, shows range quickly.

what: Different scenes cut by shape-matching: a bus, green grid, tyre, biscuit, splash, until bright product bottles appear.
lesson: Match-cuts on shape and colour link unrelated objects into the product.

what: Soda bottle with lemon slices, then lime juice pours into ice glass, then a person sips and smiles.
lesson: Pour then sip gives a taste payoff in three beats.

what: Food icons on coloured tiles assemble: burger layers stack, cupcake and pancakes build, ice cream and drinks animate.
lesson: Stacked layers popping in one by one make simple food readable in a grid.

what: Noodle pack in hand, noodles cooked, family cooking, a boy eats, ends on a logo ribbon.
lesson: Hands, cooking, eating tells the product story in four images.

what: A pink fabric opens like a seam and a box rises out, then a hand picks it up.
lesson: A reveal that opens for the product gives a reason it arrives.

what: Rock and ice break open to reveal a bottle, cutting to boxes in other materials.
lesson: Breaking a material away to reveal the product is a strong first second.

what: A gumball machine turns into a vending machine, confetti pops and the scene resets to the machine.
lesson: Looping back to the first frame makes a clean loop.

what: A white circle with the cafe name shrinks into a brown ring, cups drop in, text rings around, then the circle returns.
lesson: A circle that opens and closes frames the product and loops.

what: Quick close shots of pizza, fries, burger, wrap and nuggets end on the brand card with order number.
lesson: Fast hero cuts end on a card with how to order.

what: Coffee making and chocolate blocks cut to a glowing package that lands and shows the brand name.
lesson: Ingredient closeups lead to the pack in light.

what: A can with neon lights and fruit explosion around it, energetic cuts.
lesson: Fruit bursting around the can says flavour.

what: Three can flavours change colour background and mascot fruit in turn.
lesson: Same layout per flavour, colour swaps carry the story.

what: Can and big word swap between orange and berry, background and fruit change with each.
lesson: Keep the can fixed, swap colour and word.

what: Ice-cream cups slide and the whole background colour and flavour name change for each flavour.
lesson: Colour per flavour makes range obvious.

what: A food card flips to show a 20% offer badge over the dish, then repeats with a pizza.
lesson: The offer badge lands on top of the real dish photo.

what: Can slides across repeating words, FRESH, TASTY, REFRESHING, then cans line up and logo appears.
lesson: Kinetic words in the flavour colours do the talking sound off.

what: A woman bites a croissant in a grand room, a croissant close-up, and golden flakes drift into text.
lesson: The bite and crumbs are the payoff.

what: A man gets a chocolate bar, friends share it, then a chocolate close-up.
lesson: Sharing shows the product in use.

what: A student studies stressed, flour and egg and milk splash, then the cake box on red.
lesson: Problem, ingredients, pack.

what: Cracked clay opens, cookie shapes press in and fill the frame, then the cookies cut to melting chocolate.
lesson: Texture that cracks to reveal the product gives a strong reason for it to appear.

what: A tiny carton grows and multiplies into a grid of coloured cartons splashing in water.
lesson: Duplicate one cutout into a flavour range with a colour per copy.

what: Watermelon pattern fills with a text headline, then wipes to a wedge on pale blue with a zero calories claim.
lesson: Let the product texture be the background first, then wipe to the clean product.

what: Two hands meet, then pizza boxes slide in, open and show the pizza.
lesson: Hands doing a small action give a reason for the product to arrive.

what: A burger lifts apart layer by layer on red until just the bottom bun remains.
lesson: Take the product apart in order to show what is in it.

what: On green, a coffee cup drops in and the word COFFEE builds around it letter by letter.
lesson: Spell the product name around the product on a solid colour for sound-off clarity.

what: On red a head silhouette fills and a pizza slice sits in the mind as text says what a delicious mind looks like.
lesson: One clear visual joke plus short text sells craving.

what: A plate of snacks slides in on a split red and white ground and the headline lands on the opposite side.
lesson: Split the screen so the product and the line have their own halves.

what: The camera pushes into a bun, a label wipes on, then it cuts inside to the patty.
lesson: Push in to the product, then cut inside to show what it is made of.

what: Chocolate splashes up under a tiramisu slice and lifts it on the splash.
lesson: A splash that lifts the product gives a reason for it to rise.

what: Coffee beans rain down into a heap on a dark spotlit floor.
lesson: Pour into a dark ground with a single light so the pile reads in a second.

what: Nuts float in slow motion and a chocolate swirl wipes across the last frame.
lesson: Float the ingredients, then wipe through the product's own flavour.

what: A burger appears, then fries and cola build around it with the combo headline typed in letter by letter.
lesson: Add one item per beat so the full combo is complete at the end.

what: A chip drops into water with a big splash and surfaces as fries.
lesson: The product enters water so the splash shows freshness.

what: Scattered pieces on beige pull into an orderly ring around the centre.
lesson: Scattered items falling into formation read as order from chaos.

what: A donut dips in chocolate and the glaze flips to pink on the next dip.
lesson: Show the flavours as one repeated dip with a colour change.

what: Chocolate runs down a brownie stack, the camera pushes inside the crumb and ends on a close cut.
lesson: Push the camera into the texture the viewer wants to taste.

what: A brown coffee capsule lid rotates and flips to a red lid.
lesson: One rotation swaps colour to show two variants.

what: In a cafe, pastries appear on a table in front of seated people, then the cut goes to the counter.
lesson: Let products pop into a real scene to link them to the place.

what: A brand name on the sea changes to a hand moving a chess piece.
lesson: A match cut to a new scene makes a story from one object.

what: Large type fills a red ground, then the pizza slice lifts in front with the offer lines underneath.
lesson: Big type first, then the product enters in front of it.

what: A green wrapper peels back over the hazelnuts to reveal the bar.
lesson: Peel a package layer to reveal the inside.

what: A bottle zooms up from a pattern of the same colours and ends with a mirrored pattern.
lesson: Use the brand pattern as both ground and wipe.

what: A cake slice on a plate lifts apart into layers in the air.
lesson: Float the layers up to show what the cake is made of.

what: A plastic cup of coffee sits still then bursts into a big splash.
lesson: Stillness then a sudden splash gives the cup an event.

what: A group faces a food truck and an ice cream grows over it.
lesson: A people shot ends on an oversized product reveal.

what: A woman juggles a can, tosses it up and it lands in the foreground as a close hero.
lesson: Real throw and catch gives a natural arrival to a hero close-up.

what: The street view tilts up to reveal a huge can on a tower.
lesson: A tilt-up reveal makes a small product feel enormous.

what: A bottle in ice and lemons zooms into ice and ends on a crystal frame.
lesson: Zoom into the product's cold texture.

what: A lift floor counter counts up, the door opens on a cherry.
lesson: A countdown builds suspense for the reveal.
